title: 陰XOR陽
author: nahiko
facts: two-layer neural network: 2 inputs, 2 hidden neurons, 1 output (MLP)
the XOR result as one boolean
description: Three neurons in two layers compute XOR. XOR is a logic rule: the output is true when exactly one of the two inputs is true. The artist minted (created) this work in August 2021 as an NFT with one token. The artist and the collector each set one input. The network turns the two inputs into yin, yang, or a blend. The weights are fixed values in the contract, and anyone can read them. The model runs fully inside Ethereum.

call.note: isYingYang() runs the model on the two stored inputs and returns the XOR result as true or false.
